title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Billère)
description_clean: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre visionNotre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de PennylanePennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois : - Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. 4 à 6 mois : - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits. Et ensuite... : - Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients. Compétences requises - De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit. 🤝 Process de recrutement ● Une première rencontre avec notre Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)sLes tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :  Notre data policy🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description_clean:
The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow.
Tasks
Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline

Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems.
Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units.
Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations.
Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases.

Data Infrastructure & Accessibility

Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB.
Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization.
Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage.
Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data.
Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve.

Data Quality & Analysis Support

Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams.
Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database.
Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline.
Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews.
Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations.
Support custom querying of processed datasets.

Requirements
Education & Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database time-series data engineering (aerospace, automotive, or racing/motorsports preferred).
Hands-on experience working directly with physical aircraft/vehicle sensor installations, DAQ hardware, and telemetry pipelines.

Technical & Domain Expertise
1. Hardware, Sensors & DAQ Architecture

Strong understanding of physical sensors (e.g., strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, RTDs, LVDTs, pitot-static tubes).
Demonstrated knowledge of signal conditioning, sampling rate selection, anti-aliasing filtering, scaling, and sensor calibration procedures.

2. Data Infrastructure & Software Development

Proficient in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automated data processing, and visualization library development (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy).
Experience working with time-series databases, specifically InfluxDB (or similar engines), including writing efficient queries (Flux/InfluxQL) and data retrieval pipelines.
Solid foundation in data structures and memory/CPU optimization when handling high-memory high-frequency continuous time-series datasets.

3. Data Integrity & Signal Processing

Experience with timestamping and clock synchronization protocols across distributed DAQ hardware and storage nodes.
Knowledge of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts (filtering, FFT, spectral analysis, decimation/resampling).

Soft Skills & Work Style

Cross-functional communication: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware technicians, flight physics/aerodynamics engineers, and software teams.
Detail-oriented mindset: Uncompromising rigor regarding calibration metadata, unit conversions, and data accuracy.
Adaptability: Drive to continuously improve data infrastructure as aircraft sensor counts, test frequencies, and analytical needs expand.

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

Knowledge of standard FAA / EASA flight test instrumentation requirements or military flight test standards (e.g. IRIG 106).
Familiarity with dashboarding tools (e.g., Grafana) for rapid post-flight previews and real-time telemetry display.
Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for internal engineering tool distribution.
Direct experience with DAQ systems and digital bus protocols (CAN bus, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, PCM).
Familiarity with binary flight data formats (e.g., IRIG 106 Chapter 10/11, MDF/MF4, HDF5, Parquet, or custom binary loggers).
Experience with performing on-aircraft hardware troubleshooting (e.g., tracking down ground loops, signal noise, dropouts, or faulty scaling).

title: Solutions Architect
description_clean: About PlanePlane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agentsWe believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the roleOur largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. What you'll doOwn the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work.Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist.Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one.Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front.Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one.Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork. What you'll bringYou have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer, and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design.You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file, including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you.You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision, not a reassurance.You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call, including the parts where the answer is no or not yet.You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow, because you will not be in the room when they run it. Nice to havesYou have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries.You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on.You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically.You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them. TechBackend: Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, RedisMessaging: RabbitMQ, KafkaInfrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and HelmIdentity: SAML, OIDC, SCIMEveryday tools: GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, SlackWhy Plane?Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer. The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role. Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you. Plane is an equal opportunity employer. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre visionNotre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de PennylanePennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois : - Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. 4 à 6 mois : - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits. Et ensuite... : - Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients. Compétences requises - De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit. 🤝 Process de recrutement ● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib💻 Un Mac🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)sLes tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :  Notre data policy🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren🇪🇸 Datos personalesPennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más informaciónFind more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description_clean: Kom stage lopen bij een van Nederlands toonaangevende kantoren in advocatuur en notariaatBen jij een rechtenstudent in de laatste fase van je studie en wil je ervaren hoe het eraan toegaat bij een groeiend, ambitieus en vernieuwend fullservice kantoor? title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description_clean: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.About the VentureAI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.About the RoleAs one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production.There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.What You’ll Work OnYour first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment.Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.Our StackOur backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.About YouYou enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually.We are looking for:Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code.Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.Fluent English is required; German is a plus.Why JoinAt this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. We believe agentic engineering can fundamentally change what a small, technically strong team is capable of building, and we're looking for people who want to push that approach forward. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible. description_clean:

Warum gibt es diese Rolle - und warum jetzt?
Lovebetter wächst in eine neue Phase. Wir haben eine klare Mission, starke Inhalte, eine etablierte Marke und zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, noch mehr Männer zu erreichen und nachhaltig zu wachsen.
In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unterschiedliche Marketingkanäle aufgebaut, Partnerschaften entwickelt und wertvolle Erfahrungen gesammelt. Jetzt wollen wir diese Aktivitäten noch besser miteinander verbinden, neue Wachstumschancen erschließen und unsere Ideen schneller in die Umsetzung bringen.
Dafür suchen wir dich.
Als Growth & Marketing Manager bist du eine zentrale operative Kraft in unserem Marketing. Du verbindest kreatives Denken mit analytischem Verständnis, entwickelst eigene Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Kampagnen, Tests und Ergebnisse werden.
Diese Rolle ist bewusst breiter als ein klassischer Marketingjob. Du wirst nicht nur einen einzelnen Kanal betreuen, sondern in ganz unterschiedlichen Bereichen mitarbeiten, eigenständig Verantwortung übernehmen und neue Themen vorantreiben.
Du musst dafür nicht alles bereits können. Entscheidend ist, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst, lösungsorientiert denkst und Lust hast, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen.
Wofür Lovebetter steht
Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.
Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.
Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Mission mitgestalten möchte, Verantwortung übernimmt und versteht, dass wirkungsvolles Marketing Kreativität, analytisches Denken und konsequente Umsetzung verbindet.
Deine Mission als Growth & Marketing Manager
Du machst Lovebetters Marketing vielseitiger, effizienter und wachstumsstärker.
Du entwickelst Marketingideen, setzt Kampagnen um, betreust bestehende und neue Wachstumskanäle und erkennst anhand von Daten, was funktioniert und wo wir besser werden können.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CMO, unseren Content-Produzenten, Agenturen und externen Partnern zusammen.
Du übernimmst eigenständig Projekte – von der ersten Idee über die operative Umsetzung bis zur anschließenden Auswertung. Dabei bewegst du dich selbstverständlich zwischen kreativen, analytischen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Deine Aufgaben

Marketingkampagnen entwickeln und umsetzen: Du planst und realisierst kanalübergreifende Marketingmaßnahmen, entwickelst kreative Ansätze und begleitest Kampagnen von der Idee bis zur Erfolgsauswertung.
Neue Wachstumskanäle erschließen: Du identifizierst neue Möglichkeiten, unsere Zielgruppe zu erreichen, recherchierst Potenziale, entwickelst erste Tests und hilfst dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze systematisch auszubauen.

Content und Creatives mitgestalten: Du entwickelst Themen, Hooks, Texte und Kampagnenideen, erstellst Briefings und arbeitest mit unseren Content-Produzenten an Inhalten für unterschiedliche Plattformen und Marketingkanäle.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander.
Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben.
Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren.
Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen.
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt.

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden
ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert
neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden
bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen
optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen
effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI
ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet

welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast
wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist
wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren
welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest
und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst

Stellenanforderungen

Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)
Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast
du sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch denkst und Spaß daran hast, zwischen unterschiedlichen Aufgaben zu wechseln
du eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mitbringst und lieber ins Machen kommst, als lange über Möglichkeiten zu diskutieren
du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und dir neue Tools, Plattformen oder Fähigkeiten eigenständig aneignen kannst
du auch vor unbekannten Herausforderungen nicht zurückschreckst und den Mut hast, Neues auszuprobieren

du strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest, Prioritäten setzen kannst und auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick behältst
du KI bereits aktiv nutzt oder motiviert bist, sie schnell und sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren
du sehr gut auf Deutsch kommunizierst und ein Gespür für überzeugende Texte und zielgruppengerechte Ansprache hast
du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

du ausschließlich in einer einzelnen Marketingdisziplin arbeiten möchtest und wenig Interesse an anderen Bereichen hast
du für neue Aufgaben immer eine detaillierte Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung brauchst
du lieber Konzepte entwickelst, als sie selbst umzusetzen
du bei unbekannten Tools oder Herausforderungen schnell aufgibst, statt nach Lösungen zu suchen

du Verantwortung lieber abgibst, statt Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben

Or, la proximité de ces sites avec les populations rend leurs déploiements incertains et soulève des questions relatives à l’acceptabilité sociale.La surveillance à long terme des sites de stockage de CO2, exigée par la directive européenne CCS, constitue une opportunité pour renforcer la transparence et l’acceptation locale du stockage en engageant les parties prenantes dans l’acquisition et l’interprétation des données. Cependant, les systèmes actuels de surveillance ne permettent pas à la fois de réaliser des mesures in-situ, simulations numériques et visualisation interactive pour une approche du suivi intégrée des sites de stockage. Le projet CO2MET vise à développer et faire progresser des unités ou éléments clés pour préparer un futur système intégré de surveillance numérique à long terme améliorant la fiabilité et l’acceptabilité du stockage géologique de CO2.Pour atteindre ces objectifs, le consortium CO2MET a été constitué et est composé de l'IFPEN, du BRGM, de Mines Saint-Etienne et de Cerema.La surveillance à long terme nécessite des outils fiables et performants, notamment dans le domaine des capteurs environnementaux, ce qui soulève la question de la mise en œuvre de mesures correctives pour traiter le signal, ainsi que celle de l'influence des variations à long terme des paramètres externes sur la réponse des capteurs (et de l'impact du changement climatique). Étant donné que les signaux de concentration en CO₂ peuvent, à eux seuls, ne pas être suffisamment discriminants (les concentrations biologiques dans les sols pouvant dépasser 10 % vol.), compte tenu de leurs origines diverses (sources profondes, provenant du stockage ou de l’interaction gaz-roche ; processus de respiration ; oxydation du méthane), la prévention des faux positifs dans la surveillance des sites de stockage doit s'appuyer sur des capteurs de CO₂ (NDIR ou photoacoustiques) et sur d'autres capteurs (par exemple, un capteur chimique d'O₂), ainsi que sur des capteurs environnementaux (humidité, pression, température) afin de permettre une attribution correcte de la source de CO2.Parmi les missions qui lui seront attribuées, le doctorant devra :· Sélectionner des capteurs existants répondants aux spécifications afin de mettre au point une plateforme de détection · Etudier, en conditions de laboratoire, la sélectivité des capteurs vis-à-vis des espèces gazeuses interférentes, à l’aide d’une analyse multivariée· Définir des algorithmes de prédiction tenant compte de la reproductibilité, de la dérive, de la linéarité et de la variabilité dans des mélanges gazeux complexes et des conditions environnementales variables (température, pression et humidité relative)· Etudier l'influence du vieillissement des capteurs sur leur réponse et sur les prévisions établies, afin de proposer un algorithme de compensation·  Enfin, mener des études de cas concrets sur le site de Sainte-Marguerite (Puy-de-Dôme), avec des niveaux d'émissions de CO₂ variables, afin de tester et de valider les plateformes de capteurs développées.Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.  🔍 Ce que nous recherchonsVous êtes titulaire d’un :· Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalentEt idéalement :· Titulaire d’un de master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Mesure / Instrumentation / Métrologie ; title: Edge & Machine Integration Engineer (PLC to Cloud), Freelance, m/f/d
description_clean:
FALU AG in Rüti (ZH) builds and sells swab production machines that run in plants around the world. With FALU PMAS, our cloud based production monitoring and assistance system, every machine reports its state every five seconds. Customers get live dashboards, shift KPIs, downtime analytics and automatic alerts in the browser. The first customer went live in September 2026 with eight machines, and more plants are lined up.
The cloud side of PMAS is built and running in production: broker, ingestion service, databases, web app. The path from the PLC inside the machine to the MQTT broker is covered by one engineer who designed and built it. With more machines and more plants coming, that one person is no longer enough. We are looking for a freelancer who adds capacity on exactly this path: PLC software, Raspberry Pi edge devices, site gateway, broker connection.
This is a permanent role that we staff on a freelance basis: no project end date, a long term engagement with about 1 week of work per month, with more when a rollout is on. You will work directly with our existing integration engineer, our inhouse engineering team and the CEO.
Tasks
You work on everything between the machine PLC and the MQTT broker, alongside the engineer who built the current setup. Which parts you take over completely and which you share depends on your strengths. Concretely:
PLC and machine side

Bring the PMAS message format into the CB1 machine software (Siemens S7, TIA Portal V18 with HMI) and keep it in sync with the payload contract: cumulative counters, machine status, error codes, timestamps from the PLC clock.
Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.
Manage PLC software versions across the fleet, including safe update and rollback procedures for machines already running at customers.
Ensure clock discipline on the PLCs (NTP, local time zone per plant), since every duration KPI is computed from PLC timestamps.

Edge devices and site gateway

Develop and maintain the software on the Raspberry Pi based edge devices next to each machine: MQTT client, buffering and store and forward during uplink outages, unique client IDs, credential handling, health reporting.
Develop and maintain the site gateway: isolated machine network, routing and firewall, outbound only TLS and NTP, remote maintenance access, watchdogs, recovery from a spare device.
Help turn the current setup into a provisioning process: golden image, per machine configuration, fleet wide updates without a site visit. A new machine goes from unboxing to "visible in the dashboard" in under an hour.
Monitor the edge layer so that we know about a degraded device before the customer does.

Broker and data contract

Administer the HiveMQ Cloud clusters per customer: credentials, topic ACLs, client ID scheme, certificates.
Maintain the payload contract together with the existing integration engineer. Changes are versioned and documented.

Commissioning and support

Onboard new customers and new machines end to end, remotely where possible and on site where needed (primarily Europe and the United States).
Act as second line when "the dashboard shows nothing" or "the numbers look wrong" and the cause sits between PLC and broker.
Write the documentation you would have wanted on day one: onboarding sheets, runbooks, wiring notes.

Requirements
Must have

Siemens PLC programming in TIA Portal (SCL and LAD, S7-1200/1500 family). You can open an existing machine project, understand it and change it without breaking the machine.
Industrial networking: PROFINET, VLANs, static and DHCP setups, firewalls, TLS basics. You have connected a machine to a network that was not built for it.
Linux on Raspberry Pi or comparable single board computers: systemd, networking, images, headless operation, remote administration.
Solid programming skills in Python or Node.js for edge software, and Git as a daily tool.
MQTT in depth: versions 3.1.1 and 5.0, QoS levels, retained messages, last will, TLS, broker ACLs.
Proficiency with AI coding tools is a hard requirement. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or comparable tools every day, you write and maintain project instructions for them, you review their output critically, and you are measurably faster with them than without. Our code and documentation are written with and for these tools. If you see AI tools as optional, this role is not for you.
Working proficiency in English (all code, commits and documentation are in English). German is a plus for the machine side.
Willingness to travel to customer plants, typically a few days per quarter.
Availability of at least two days per week on a permanent basis, with the option to scale up during rollouts.
You work as a freelancer (own company or registered self employed) and can invoice FALU AG.

Nice to have

OPC UA, Snap7 or the Siemens open communication libraries.
Node-RED, Docker on ARM, Ansible or similar fleet tooling.
Machine building or commissioning experience: reading electrical schematics, 24 V control cabinet basics, HMI (WinCC).
Administration of HiveMQ, Mosquitto or EMQX.
A basic understanding of what happens after the broker (Node.js services, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), so that you can talk to the cloud side at eye level.

Benefits

A clearly bounded, business critical scope with a colleague who knows the system and hands over properly. No cold start.
A running production system with a real customer, not a greenfield slide deck.
AI assisted development is how we work, not an experiment. You get the tools and the budget for them.
Machines you can touch: a test bench at FALU in Rüti with real PLCs and edge hardware.
Remote by default, on site in Rüti when hardware is involved. Travel to customer plants is paid on top of the rate.
A permanent role, not a project with an end date: growing volume as more plants go live, on a freelance basis for as long as it works for both sides.
Fast, uncomplicated invoicing and decisions from a small team.

If you have ever made a stubborn PLC talk to the cloud and have capacity to do it again with us, we would like to hear from you.
Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, your daily rate and availability, one paragraph about a PLC to cloud integration you built or fixed and what went wrong on the way, and one concrete example of how you use AI tools in your daily engineering work.
What to expect: a short call with Marc Wyss (CEO) within a week of your application, then a small practical task with a simulated PLC data source, a Raspberry Pi image and a broker endpoint. We look at how you work, not just at the result. After that, one conversation with our integration engineer and the team, then a decision and a contract.Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Cloud Operations Lead
description_clean:
Welcome to Xelon – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity. As we continue to grow our Platform team, we are looking for a 
Cloud Operations Lead (80-100%)
to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.
At Xelon, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From IaaS to SaaS, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like technology, finance, insurance, and public services. Our solutions - Xelon Cloud, Xelon Secure+ and Xelon HQ combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.
We are on a mission to become the #1 Swiss Cloud Enabler, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.
Tasks
Your Mission
As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.
Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.
Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform & Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.
What You Own in the First 12 Months

Availability and customer satisfaction. You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.
ISO 27001 and audit readiness. Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.
Team depth. No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.

Responsibilities

Operations and multi-hypervisor environment: Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.
Networking, storage and datacenter: Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.
Monitoring, incident response and recovery: Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.
Service desk and customer support: Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.
Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.
Automation and process: Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.
Compliance and audit readiness: Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.
Budget, vendors and procurement: Co-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform & Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.

Requirements
Who You Are
We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.

You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.
You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.
You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.
You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.
You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.

Must Haves

Leadership: 5+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.
VMware: hands-on experience in production. You have operated it yourself, not only overseen it.
Infrastructure: practical working knowledge of networking, storage and datacenter operations.
German and English: you communicate confidently in both, spoken and written.
Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to Haves

Networking at provider scale — a strong plus: segmentation, routing, firewalling, load balancing and DNS.
Experience with other hypervisors alongside VMware, and with hypervisor migrations.
Hands-on Infrastructure as Code, e.g. Terraform or Ansible.
Monitoring and logging at scale, e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or a similar stack.
Operating experience in a regulated environment: ISO 27001, ISAE or SOC 2.
Running operations through a platform migration or a consolidation.

Benefits
What Xelon Offers

A leadership role with real ownership in a Swiss cloud provider, not a coordination layer.
A platform in transition, which means your operational decisions change something visible.
Office in Zug with a hybrid working model, 80 to 100 percent.
Direct collaboration with the Head of Platform & Technology and cross-functional teams.
A team small enough that you know what everyone is working on.
Competitive salary, modern tooling and a product-driven environment with clarity and ownership.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description_clean:
VAULTED AG is a Swiss deep-tech scale-up born out of research at ETH Zurich and the EMPA innovation ecosystem. We combine world-class engineering, computational design, digital fabrication, and advanced manufacturing to rethink how buildings are designed and delivered, at a time when AI, automation, and data-driven design are transforming the industry.
Our core technology is the Rippmann Floor System® (RFS), a lightweight, prefabricated structural floor system that reduces concrete use by up to 70%, steel use by up to 90%, and embodied carbon by up to 75% compared with conventional concrete slabs. After years of research and technology development, VAULTED is entering a major growth phase across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, and the US.
Location: Dübendorf ZH, Switzerland · Start date: Q1 2027 · 100% · Reporting to the CEO
Tasks
We are hiring a Chief Operating Officer to build the operational engine that turns confirmed projects into reliable, profitable, and scalable delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep project and construction industry understanding with strong operational and commercial judgement, but also someone who is very hands-on and enjoys setting up the systems and processes behind our operations.
The COO takes ownership once a project is won and oversees project delivery, project management, supplier and prefabrication partnerships, operational contracting, and project economics. The role ensures that scope, timelines, quality, risks, resources, costs, and margins are transparent and actively managed, while giving project teams the structure and support they need to deliver.
A core mandate is to make VAULTED better with every project: translate project learnings into stronger processes, supplier setups, handovers, delivery standards, and feedback to engineering and R&D. The COO builds the operational capabilities required to scale across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, and the US without adding unnecessary complexity. This is a 100% role.

Operational leadership & project delivery: Build and lead the operating model required to deliver VAULTED projects reliably and efficiently. Oversee the project management function, set clear execution standards, and support escalation and decision-making on active projects.
Project economics & controlling: Establish disciplined project controlling across budgets, costs, forecasts, changes, and margins, ensuring deviations and commercial implications are visible early and actively addressed.
Supplier, production & prefabrication ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage production partners, suppliers, and prefabricators across relevant markets, ensuring quality, capacity, cost competitiveness, and delivery reliability.
Contracting, procurement & operational risk: Shape supplier and operational contracts, procurement approaches, and partnership models that improve delivery certainty, manage risk, protect margins, and maintain strategic flexibility.
Cross-functional leadership & resources: Connect project management, engineering, design, R&D, commercial teams, and external partners. Create clarity on priorities, responsibilities, capacity, and trade-offs, and ensure smooth handovers from sales into execution.
Continuous improvement & international scaling: Turn project learnings into better processes, standards, supplier setups, and execution methods, while building operational readiness for Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, the US, and future markets.

Requirements

Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in project delivery, operations, construction, architecture, or prefabrication, preferably with an engineering background.
Proven responsibility for complex, multi-stakeholder projects or project portfolios, with the ability to oversee execution while staying close enough to intervene when needed.
Strong practical understanding of how construction or engineered products move from design and procurement through production, coordination, and delivery.
Strong commercial and financial discipline, including project budgets, cost drivers, forecasting, margins, change management, and operational risk.
Experience negotiating and managing suppliers, production partners, contracts, and long-term operational relationships.
Strong leadership skills with high empathy and high standards: able to build trust, set clear expectations, challenge constructively, make decisions, and hold teams and partners to commitments.
Strategic and hands-on working style: able to build scalable systems and processes while staying pragmatic, close to project realities, and comfortable solving difficult execution issues.
Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage. Based in Zurich/Dübendorf, or willing to work primarily from Dübendorf, with occasional national and international travel to project, production, and construction sites.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d) in Berlin.  
Unser Team bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für einen Technischen Outsourcing-Manager (m/w/d), der als Vermittler zwischen unserem High-Tech-Kunden und den Remote-Teams in Bulgarien fungieren wird. Als Technischer Outsourcing-Manager schaffen, pflegen und erweitern Sie Geschäftsbeziehungen, indem Sie langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden aufbauen und verwalten. Sie fungieren als Bindeglied zwischen dem Kunden und dem Team in Bulgarien und unterstützen diese mit Ihrem technischen Wissen und umfassenden Erfahrungen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner werden Sie neue Leads managen und diese zu Nearshoring-Projekten entwickeln; Engineering-Anfragen diskutieren und Einblicke aus verschiedenen Kundenabteilungen einbringen.  
Sie werden den Kunden regelmäßig besuchen. Sie sind für Kundenbeziehungen verantwortlich und der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei den betreffenden Projekten in einem komplexen, anspruchsvollen und sich häufig ändernden Umfeld. Sie haben ein Auge dafür, Abweichungen in Qualität, Lieferzeit und Budget zu erkennen, diese anzusprechen und zu managen. Um das Bewusstsein für die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu schaffen, bringen Sie diese „Signale“ und das Kundenfeedback in das Team ein. Sie gewährleisten eine bidirektionale Kommunikation und managen Eskalationen vom Team in Sofia zum Kunden. Ihre Erfahrung bringt Verantwortung und Eigenverantwortung in die Projekte, was sicherstellt, dass unsere Lösungen nachhaltig und umfassend in die Organisationen unserer Kunden eingebettet sind.  
Zusätzliche Verantwortung:  

Kommunikation mit Kunden auf mehreren Ebenen; mit technischen Spezialisten, Projektmanagern, Fachleitern und zugewiesenem Personal, das in die Projekte involviert ist

Abstimmung der Anforderungen (funktional und technisch), Projektplanung, Nachverfolgung und Berichterstattung
Technische Beratung in Ihrem Fachgebiet
Fungieren als (technische) Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden und den Remote-Entwicklungsteams
Mitwirkung an der Erstellung und Abstimmung der (langfristigen) Outsourcing-Produkt-Roadmap/Vision mit relevanten Stakeholdern
Schließen von Lücken, die durch Nearshoring entstehen, und Entwicklung struktureller Lösungen
Erstellung von Budgets für Ingenieurvorschläge
Initiierung von Folgeprojektverkäufen und Verwaltung zusätzlicher Budgets
Identifizierung neuer Leads in Ihrem Tätigkeitsbereich

title: Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director
description_clean:
Aritec New Materials Group AG is a Swiss-based company specialized in fiber composite solutions for demanding industrial applications.  
We are experts in synthetic fibers, treatments & fiber sizing formulations and polymer matrices. We take pride in engineering and optimizing superior solutions to the most complex industrial challenges.  
At Aritec, we drive tomorrow’s industrial frontiers by innovating cost-effective and robust solutions.
Tasks
We are seeking an accomplished Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director to lead commercial growth for advanced reinforcement solutions used in industrial transmission belts (timing, power transmission, etc..). This is a senior, customer-facing role for a commercially driven technical professional who understands belt construction, reinforcement architecture, manufacturing processes, end-user performance requirements, and the evolving challenges facing belt manufacturers and end-users worldwide.
The successful candidate will bring a strong track record and industry network from a leading belt manufacturer or closely related high-performance belting business. They will use their industry credibility, technical depth, and commercial judgment to build strategic customer relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and position our reinforcement portfolio as a performance-enabling solution for next-generation belt designs.
As Business Development Director, you will work at the intersection of materials engineering, belt design, manufacturing, and commercial strategy. You will engage with global belt manufacturers, technical centers, R&D teams, purchasing organizations, and senior business leaders to advance qualification projects and convert them into durable commercial programs.
Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the global sales strategy for Aritec reinforcement portfolio in Transmission belts.
Build and manage senior-level relationships with major transmission-belt manufacturers, including engineering, R&D, purchasing, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
Manage and Expand existing customers account portfolio by identifying and prioritizing opportunities where Aritec Synthetic reinforcement technology can improve belt strength, fatigue performance, dimensional stability, heat resistance, flex life, adhesion, noise behavior, efficiency, or durability.
Translate customer performance requirements into clear technical and commercial value propositions.
Lead customer-development programs from initial technical discussion through sampling, testing, qualification, industrialization, and serial-production launch.
Coordinate closely with internal R&D, application engineering, operations, quality, product management, and supply-chain teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered.
Provide informed market intelligence on belt technologies, competitive reinforcement materials, regional market dynamics, pricing trends, supply-chain risks, and emerging end-use requirements.
Support the development of account plans, commercial agreements, pricing strategies, forecasts, and long-term supply arrangements.
Represent the company at customer technical reviews, industry events, trade fairs, and relevant technical associations.
Establish disciplined sales reporting, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and business-review processes.
Mentor and develop regional sales or application-engineering colleagues as the business grows.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
At least 10 years of relevant commercial, technical-sales, business-development, product-management, application-engineering, or R&D experience in transmission belts, reinforced elastomer products, industrial belting, tire cord, technical textiles, fibers, or closely related applications.
Experience gained at a recognized transmission-belt manufacturer is strongly preferred. Candidates from leading global manufacturers of automotive and industrial transmission belts will be particularly well suited.
Demonstrated understanding of transmission-belt construction, including reinforcement cords or fabrics, rubber compounds, bonding systems, cover materials, belt geometry, and manufacturing processes.
Practical familiarity with belt types such as timing belts, synchronous belts, V-belts, multi-rib belts, variable-speed belts, flat belts, and industrial power-transmission belts.
Strong understanding of key reinforcement performance factors, including tensile properties, modulus, elongation, creep, fatigue, flex resistance, adhesion, thermal stability, moisture behavior, dimensional stability, and processability.
Established relationships within the global transmission-belt industry are highly desirable.
Proven ability to manage technically complex sales cycles involving testing, qualification, supply approval, and multi-site customer coordination.
Experience negotiating pricing, supply agreements, development agreements, technical specifications, and long-term customer programs.
Strong commercial acumen, including margin management, value-based selling, forecasting, market analysis, and strategic account planning.
Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Preferred Technical Background
The ideal candidate will have direct familiarity with one or more of the following:

Aramid, polyester, glass, carbon, hybrid, or other high-performance reinforcement materials.
Cord construction, twisting, cabling, dipping, coating, or adhesion-promotion systems.
Rubber-to-cord and polymer-to-cord adhesion technologies.
Belt fatigue testing, tensile testing, dynamic testing, flex testing, endurance testing, and field-performance validation.
Belt-manufacturing processes, including calendering, building, molding, curing, grinding, machining, and quality-control systems.
Customer qualification practices and industrial quality-assurance processes.

Personal Attributes

Credible technical expert who can communicate effectively with both R&D engineers and senior commercial leaders.
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable building business in technically demanding markets.
Structured and disciplined in account management, forecasting, and opportunity prioritization.
Skilled listener who can uncover the underlying technical and commercial drivers behind customer needs.
Collaborative leader who works effectively across sales, operations, R&D, quality, and supply chain.
Resilient and patient in managing long qualification cycles while maintaining urgency and commercial focus.
High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and ethical business conduct.

Benefits
This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial direction of a high-value reinforcement business serving a critical industrial market. You will have the autonomy to influence strategy, engage directly with leading belt manufacturers, and help develop materials that enable more efficient, durable, lightweight, and sustainable power-transmission systems.

Position: Founder Brand & Communications InternWorkload: 60%Duration: 6 monthsLocation: Lucerne, SwitzerlandWorking model: office-basedStart date: December 1st, 2026 or by agreement

Conferences, panels and speaking opportunities

Universities, cultural organisations and professional networks

Potential collaborations and partnerships involving the founder and/or Salona Consulting

Writes very well in English
